name: Computer Science
description: Computer science programmes teach how computation works and how to build software that is correct, efficient and maintainable — algorithms, data structures, operating systems, networks, languages and the discrete mathematics underneath them. It is the most theoretical of Florida's four computing programmes, and the usual route into software development.
degreesNote: Florida awards this at every level: state-college certificates, an A.S. or A.A., the bachelor's degree most software work expects, and master's and doctoral degrees above it. ⚠ Ask the transfer question early, because it is the one that costs people a year: an A.S. in a computing field is a CAREER degree built to lead to work and does not always transfer into a university computer science bachelor's, where the A.A. route normally does. ⚠⚠ And check the SECOND programming course specifically — Florida numbers it five different ways, all at upper division, and it is the commonest point at which a state-college sequence fails to substitute. ⚠ Accreditation comes from ABET's COMPUTING commission, not its engineering commission, and nothing in software employment requires it; there is no licence.

cips.note: Computer science proper. ⚠ Only four Florida public institutions file under it — Florida Poly 111, UNF 67, USF 54, UWF 33, 265 graduates in 2023 — which is why it cannot be the whole of this programme.

Computer and information sciences, general — where Florida actually files most of its computer science degrees: 15 public institutions and 3,047 graduates in 2023, the largest computing code in the state.
Artificial intelligence — 4 Florida public institutions, 41 graduates. A new and fast-growing code, and squarely a computer science degree rather than an applied one.
Computer and information sciences, other — 1 institution, 63 graduates. Included so a programme filed under the residual code is not lost.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The distinction that matters most and is least obvious from the names. Computer science is about how computation WORKS — algorithms, theory, building systems from scratch. Information technology is about running and integrating systems that exist. ⚠ IT is far more widely taught in Florida (39 public institutions against 16) and is the faster route to a job; computer science is the one most software-developer job adverts name and the one that transfers into graduate study.

⚠ The hardware side of the same boundary, and usually an ENGINEERING degree rather than a computing one — which changes the accrediting body and the mathematics. If embedded systems, chips or robotics are the draw, compare the two directly; it is much easier to move from computer engineering into software than the reverse.

The overlap is large and growing: both teach programming and algorithms, but data science adds statistics, machine learning and study design. ⚠ Read both if analytics is the goal — at many institutions the difference is four or five courses.
The inference half of data work, and the part a computing degree covers least. A statistics minor or double major on a computing degree is the combination most data job adverts are describing.
